Synopsis:
    Cuba's Foreign Minister Bruno Rodriguez confirmed zero negotiations with the US, while citing $8.1B in annual embargo-related damages (+7% YoY). The Trump administration's oil blockade has caused severe energy shortages and cascading humanitarian consequences (blackouts, food spoilage, water-borne illness). The UN has condemned the sanctions as violations of international law. No diplomatic resolution is in sight.
